stem.text: Assuming that one particular molecule of the polymer forms from $n$ molecules of the monomer (where $n$ is many thousands), which statements are correct?

items: The relative molecular mass of this polymer molecule is approximately $62.5n$.
There are $n$ chiral carbon atoms in this polymer molecule.
There are $5n\ \sigma$ bonds in one polymer molecule.
